title: Booking API latency regression (synthetic)
summary: A slow ORM query added in release 2026.10.2 raised booking API p95 latency.
impact: p95 latency 2.8 s (SLO threshold 2 s) for 47 minutes; 12% of booking requests counted as bad; 9% of monthly latency budget consumed.
root_causes: New query lacked an index on appointments(tenant_id, starts_at)
contributing_factors: Load test dataset had 10x fewer appointments than production
Query plan not reviewed for new repository methods
detection: Burn-rate alert paged 12 minutes after deploy.
response: On-call rolled back the release; incident commander coordinated.
